answer: A collateral-slashing mechanism curbs Sybil attacks without relying on an ivory tower of centralized authorities. Agents lock verifiable financial stake into an escrow contract periodically sampled by a randomness beacon, establishing authenticated peers across the network orchard. An adversary must commit scarce capital per identity, making large-scale forgery economically prohibitive. However, this capital barrier disadvantages resource-poor agents and encourages plutocratic control.
